business_problem: Legacy data warehouse architecture could not keep pace with customer, store, and marketing data volumes, limiting real-time retail decisions, personalization, and cost visibility.
solution_summary: Petco modernized its data estate on Snowflake to create a single source of truth across ecommerce, store, sales, and marketing workloads. The retailer moved away from its legacy warehouse into Snowflake's multi-cluster cloud architecture, which now supports faster sales loads and Salesforce marketing data loads while scaling with demand across more than 1,500 locations and millions of web visitors. Centralized data gives teams a 360-degree customer view that combines purchase history, browsing behavior, and channel preference so they can personalize promotions, analyze churn, and compare store performance. Petco also built live Snowflake dashboards that track usage at the warehouse, module, and individual-user level, then paired them with auto-suspend, auto-resume, transient tables, and workload tuning to control cost. Streamlit apps on top of the same foundation now extend forecasting, merchandising, and supply-chain insight directly to business teams.

data_flow: Sales, ecommerce, and Salesforce marketing data land in Snowflake, where Petco builds customer analytics, pricing and churn insights, and usage-monitoring dashboards. Segments and recommendations are shared to marketing partners, while Streamlit apps surface forecasting and supply-chain insights to business teams.
business_outcome: Petco processes data up to 50% faster, raised data-science productivity by 20%, accelerated data sharing tenfold, and used deeper customer insight to drive more tailored promotions while reducing infrastructure cost.
